output.title: New opt-in controller flag for copying Ingress/Gateway annotations
output.content: The change adds a new controller option, `--extra-certificate-annotations`, for copying chosen annotation keys from an Ingress or Gateway to the resulting Certificate. The environment's manifests show only apps/v1 Deployment and cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate, with no Ingress or Gateway resources, and none of the values keys set relate to this option. The excerpt describes a new option rather than a changed default, so nothing here reaches this environment unless the operator chooses to adopt it.
